name: godot-lsp
description: GDScript code intelligence for Claude Code. Godot exposes its language server over TCP only, while Claude Code runs every LSP server over stdio — its `transport: "socket"` option is accepted and then ignored. This bridges the two with a dependency-free 55-line pipe, so hover, go-to-definition, find-references and document symbols work on .gd files with the real engine analysis behind them, including full built-in class documentation.
